catalyst.name: Osmosis, Surplus, Traveler's Chosen Catalyst
catalyst.description:
Increases Magazine Size by 2 (15🠚17)
Grants the Surplus trait:
Grants Stat Bonuses depending on the number of Charged Abilities.
Stat Bonuses with 1|2|3+ Charged Abilities:
• 5|15|25 Stability
• 5|25|60 Handling
• 10|25|60 Reload Speed
Also grants the Osmosis trait:
Grenade Ability usage refills 50% of your Magazine (rounded up) from reserves and changes the weapon's element to match your equipped Grenade Ability until stowed.
Magazine Refill cannot be triggered again without stowing the weapon first.
Kinetic weapons lose their Passive Damage Bonus against non-Boss PVE Combatants (10% on Primary, 15% on Special).
Perks that replace your Grenade Ability (such as Gunpowder Gamble or Transcendence Grenades) will also trigger Osmosis.
